data.name: Najiah
data.gender_notes: Najiah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman of high elegance, one who inspires hope and brings light to others. The name Najiah carries the meaning “Elegant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Najiah usually hope their child will grow to embody elegant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine grace and beauty, embodying the qualities of light and hope in the hearts of those around her.
data.etymology: Najiah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Elegant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Najiah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: نجية
in_arabic.meaning: النجية تعني الناجية أو الفائزة بالسلامة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم نجية مشتق من الجذر النجوي، ويعني الناجية من المخاطر أو الفائزة بالسلامة. وردت هذه المعاني في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن النجاة والفلاح. يستخدم الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية ليدل على الأمان والسلام.

in_urdu.name: نجیہ
in_urdu.meaning: نجیہ کا مطلب ہے ناجیہ یا محفوظ رہنے والی
in_urdu.long_meaning: نجیہ نام عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے، خاص طور پر نجی (نجی) سے جو 'نجات' یا 'سلامتی' کے معنی میں ہے۔ اسلامی تقویم میں، اس نام کا استعمال محفوظ رہنے یا نجات پانے کے تصور سے منسلک ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیا میں مسلم کمیونٹی میں اس کا اہم ثقافتی اور روحانی مطلب ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नजीहा
in_hindi.meaning: नजीहा का अर्थ है सुरक्षित रहने वाली या विजयी
in_hindi.long_meaning: नजीहा नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जो 'नजाह' (निजात) से जुड़ा है, जिसका अर्थ है 'सुरक्षित रहना' या 'बचाव'। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है और सुरक्षा तथा मोक्ष की कामना से जुड़ा है।

in_pashto.name: نجیه
in_pashto.meaning: نجیه د نجات موندونکی یا خوندي پاتې معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: د نجیه نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، په ځانګړي ډول د 'نجي' (نجاة) څخه، کوم چې د 'نجات' یا 'امنیت' معنی لري. په افغان او پښتون دود کې، دا نوم د خوندي پاتې کیدو یا نجات موندنې مفهوم سره تړلی دی.

in_english.name: Najiah
in_english.meaning: Najiah means safe, victorious, or one who attains salvation
in_english.long_meaning: The name Najiah is derived from the Arabic root 'n-j-y' (نجي), which means 'to save' or 'to deliver'. This root is mentioned in the Quran (e.g., Quran 37:79), signifying salvation or safety. Historically, Najiah has been used in Islamic tradition to denote someone who is safe or victorious. The name carries spiritual significance, implying a person who achieves salvation or protection. In modern times, Najiah is used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing hope and security.

This beautiful name conveys a sense of dignity and refinement, evoking images of a woman who inspires beauty, poise, and exemplary character. In many Islamic cultures, the name Najiah is often given to a daughter as a desired and aspirational title, representing the hope for her to embody these noble qualities.
data.spiritual_significance: Moreover, Najiah holds deep spiritual significance as a name connected to hope and light. It reflects the belief that every individual holds an inner light and potential for greatness, inspiring others to find guiding hope during challenging times. The name Najiah can also be interpreted as one who finds salvation or protection in Allah, urging a deeper connection to the divine and a commitment to living a virtuous life.
